'Who lives there is a speed tool, not a new fact: each one sits in its key\'s place in the house (the Dog between the two black keys, Grandma and her Apple garden between the three) and each word starts with its key\'s letter. Watch for counting up from C on every key: ask "Who lives there?" instead. Clara belongs to the royal family: the Queen and the King arrive with the staff.'
